notes: Not checker-run. I have no shell, so every figure here is worked out by hand. The next owner runs `bun tools/plan/cli.ts`. Send failures in T-, S- or N- rules back to Vantage, or to Datum if the fix needs geometry.

S1 Skyport is held and left out of this list. At about x 535 it is over water, with no skyport ground or foot path, so nobody can walk to it. Datum (through Aster): please draw skyport ground or a foot path that joins the walkable network. I will then place and front the station, 200 m or more from Harbour (x 532 to 535, platform straight before the loop).

With Skyport held, S1 has no station at its loop end. If a terminal station is needed there, it waits on the ground request. S1 gaps: 255 m (Gardens to Circus) and 237 m (Circus to Harbour). Harbour stays at x 332 on the quay pier. Its fronts value is crown-parade (the parade ends at x 288); I will re-front it if Datum names the quay.

T1 gaps measured along the path: 310 m, 308 m and about 435 m. No stop fits in Crown Avenue: the spacing rule puts the next stop at y 228 or more, but a 30 m platform before the R50 corner needs y 224 or less. So Terraces sits on Crown Road at x −90, and the next T1 stop off-sheet must be at x −390 or further west.
T2 has five stops, so four gaps, measured on the placed chainage: 321 m, 350 m, 327 m and 305 m. The Market stop sits at x 80, outside the Boulevard and Market Street junction, 87 m from T1 Records.
Interchange pairs, each 150 m or less: T1/circus to S1/circus 119 m, T1/records to T2/market 87 m, S1/harbour to T2/parade about 25 m. The three lines form one connected network (N-C1).
N-R1 worst cases by hand, with no plot depending on Skyport: records-square 217 m, docks-east 207 m, docks-south 204 m, crescent-north 193 m, crescent-east 190 m. All are within 250 m.

For Aster: the sources conflict. The concept note still describes T1 with an R28 balloon loop and Crown Circus as the only interchange. This proposal follows Datum's run-through T1, which has three interchanges. Open question 2 is still for Sky to decide.
